g.text: Single-core SIMD performance versus requested frequency
Median and range of 3 consecutive 0.75 s intervals after 0.75 s warmup per workload. CPU 0 pinned; sibling remains online.
Clock: user core cycles / thread CPU time; requests are not guaranteed locks. No new independent process repeats.
Run state: stopped; restoration verified: True. Short test does not establish maximum sustained stable frequency.
